name: Hurricane
note: A tall, curved-sided glass sized for a long drink with a large juice component, wide enough at the mouth to carry a fruit-wedge garnish.
iceDisplacementNote: Solid ice only, scaled from the same tall-glass ratios as the highball and Collins on this site rather than measured directly: both land near 57% of capacity displaced by cubed ice and roughly 95% of that figure for a single block, and crushed packs to about a quarter more than cubed. No measured figure exists for this specific shape.
